_comment: Community-scoped objective ACC conditions (Ed/ChatGPT 2026-09-19; Phase 2 of lib/ai/EVIDENCE_READINESS.md). Boundary: the MODEL determines a rule APPLIES (produces the item / scope); CODE deterministically guarantees the required curing condition is attached, so Miranda never has to 'remember' an objective consequence. Config first — NOT a database subsystem. Each rule is community-scoped and rule-identifiable (requirement_id). `applies_when.item_type_matches` is a case-insensitive regex tested against the structured item's `type`. `_default` rules apply to every community.

_schema.required_condition: the exact curing condition text to guarantee on the item
_schema.source: governing-doc citation the condition is grounded in

Waterview Estates.required_condition: Existing stone veneer must be matched in material, color, finish, and coursing; no substitution of stone material or color is permitted without prior written ACC approval. If temporarily removed during work, it must be reinstated to match the existing exactly.
Waterview Estates.source: Waterview Estates Design Guidelines §3.9.1 (exterior materials in natural state; color harmony with existing) + prior masonry approvals
